saas-decomposer 1.0.0

- Initial release providing automated SaaS service decomposition and AI internalization planning.

- Generates detailed internalization roadmaps, including new skill specs, development timelines, and cost comparisons.
- Supports comparative analysis across multiple SaaS products in the same category.
- Includes pre-defined industry templates and troubleshooting guides for common analysis challenges.
